headline_en: Mumbai Police questioned IIT Bombay Professor Suryanarayana Doolla for hours
headline_hi: मुंबई पुलिस ने आईआईटी बॉम्बे के प्रोफेसर सूर्यनारायण डूल्ला से घंटों पूछताछ की
summary: IIT Bombay stated that Mr. Wakode was allegedly caught using his mobile phone to access ChatGPT during a mid-semester examination on September 18. Following student protests, the institute sent Professor Doolla on leave and removed him from all his positions.

headline_en: FSSAI ordered recall of Everest cumin powder for pesticide residues
headline_hi: कीटनाशक अवशेषों के लिए FSSAI ने एवरेस्ट जीरा पाउडर को वापस मंगाने का आदेश दिया
summary: On Sunday, FSSAI ordered the recall of Everest Food Products' cumin powder from the market and suspended the food license of Creative Bakers and Confectioners Pvt Ltd.

headline_en: Delhi Crime Branch investigates sexual harassment complaints filed by three female journalists
headline_hi: दिल्ली क्राइम ब्रांच ने तीन महिला पत्रकारों द्वारा दर्ज कराई गई यौन उत्पीड़न की शिकायतों की जाँच की
summary: Reports said that on Friday, Bharadwaj and Jha were detained by police, and Bharadwaj shared a video on X and spoke to ANI minutes before his detention. On Saturday, security forces detained approximately 150 people at Jantar Mantar, where three women journalists participated in the protest.

headline_en: Justice Ujjal Bhuyan calls mass voter disenfranchisement arbitrary and unconstitutional
headline_hi: न्यायमूर्ति उज्ज्वल भुयान बड़े पैमाने पर मतदाताओं के मताधिकार से वंचित किए जाने को मनमाना और असंवैधानिक बताते हैं
summary: According to reports, the Special Intensive Revision process was first initiated by the Election Commission in Bihar in June 2025. Later, on September 22, 2026, a Supreme Court bench led by CJI Surya Kant requested a response from the Election Commission regarding the voter list revision.

headline_en: Fire brigade extinguishes blaze on Ramayana film set in Mumbai
headline_hi: फायर ब्रिगेड ने मुंबई में रामायण फिल्म के सेट पर आग बुझाई
summary: Reports differ on whether a fire broke out on Monday, 5 October 2026, on the set of the film 'Ramayana' or the television show 'Hustle 5' at Film City in Goregaon, Mumbai. The fire brigade extinguished the fire at 4:55 PM that day, and no injuries were reported.
